title: Add shared tracks section to Artist page
acceptance_criteria: Artist page playlists tab shows a 'Shared Tracks' section below shared playlists
Section header reads 'Shared Tracks' with a Users icon
Tracks displayed in a grid matching the shared playlists pattern
Each shared track shows 'Shared by {sharedByDisplayName}' attribution
Empty state: 'No tracks shared with you yet' when the list is empty
All new elements have data-testid attributes
